summary: Joshua sends spies to Jericho—They are received and concealed by Rahab—They promise to preserve Rahab and her household.
meta_description: Joshua sends spies to Jericho—They are received and concealed by Rahab—They promise to preserve Rahab and her household.

footnotes.note9_b: HEB melt away; i.e., with fear. Ex. 15:15.
footnotes.note17_a: HEB pure; i.e., innocent, free from blame in this covenant. Ex. 20:7.
